judgments.proposedConclusion: One position (the deductibility of a cross-border service charge) does not meet the more-likely-than-not threshold on its technical merits; the full benefit of 25,000 USD at 2026-12-31 (15,000 USD at 2025-12-31) is unrecognized and carried as a liability, with the 10,000 USD increase in FY2026 tax expense.
